title: the thermalscapes of urban consumption: informal shading practices in a hot brazilian city centre
core_idea: Investigate how informal shading practices affect thermal comfort and the sensory atmosphere of urban consumption districts in a hot city centre, using qualitative methods (ethnography and participatory biosensing) to advance understanding of thermalscapes in urban retail contexts.
tldr: This study aims to explore the role of informal shading in shaping thermal environments and consumer experiences in a hot Brazilian city centre (Cuiabá) through ethnographic observation and participatory biosensing to contribute to research on urban thermalscapes.
